name: VISIO RED
notes:
VISIO.RED SRL - Internet service provider in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Peering: open. Requests to policy@visio.red (24x7 NOC: noc@visio.red). We announce only our own prefixes: 45.229.204.0/22 and 2803:2320::/32 (plus more-specifics), with RPKI ROAs and LACNIC IRR route objects. Please filter on the as-set AS266721:AS-VISIORED; suggested max-prefix
22 IPv4 / 32 IPv6.

Present at AR-IX CABASE Buenos Aires (2 x 10G, route servers and bilateral sessions). MD5 optional. We prefer bilateral sessions with content and cloud networks in addition to the route servers.
